description: Returns the ACF custom fields of one item with each field's label, type, field group, and value. Use it to understand what each field means; get_post already includes the values alone.

id.description: Post ID. Provide either id or slug.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of body text (and of each long ACF text field) to return

slug.description: Post slug. Provide either id or slug.

name: get_acf_fields
title: Get ACF fields with labels
